steps.title: Just Relauch the test assignment should not make the status move to 'In Progress'
Opening up review mode for a submitted test assignment or just opening a test will not automatically change that test assignment to return back to in progress status
For a test assignment to change back to ‘In progress’ from ‘Submitted’ in review mode, the user needs to change an answer.
Verify Submitted test assignment in review mode should change ‘In progress’ to ‘Submitted’.
For a test assignment to change back to ‘In progress’ from ‘Submitted’ in review mode, the user add a test to their test assignment.
